description: View, set, or reset the spending circuit breaker for your MPP32 agent session. Use 'get' to check current budget status (remaining budget, hourly velocity, circuit breaker state). Use 'set' to configure spending limits (budget cap in USD, hourly velocity limit, alert threshold percentage). Use 'reset' to manually reset a tripped circuit breaker so the session can resume spending. Circuit breakers trip automatically when budget or velocity limits are exceeded, preventing runaway agent spending.

action.description: Action: 'get' = view budget status, 'set' = update limits, 'reset' = clear tripped circuit breaker

alertThresholdPercent.description: Budget percentage at which to warn (e.g. 80 = warn at 80% spent). Only used with action='set'.

budgetLimitUsd.description: Maximum total session spend in USD. Only used with action='set'.

velocityLimitUsd.description: Maximum spend per hour in USD. Only used with action='set'.

name: manage_agent_budget
